acceptance: A downloaded artifact is traceable to its source commit without trusting operator discipline
Docs describe the residual trust assumption if full binding is overkill
context: L2 blind spots from both follow-up reviews. PUBLISHING.md mitigates by asking authors to identify the inspected run, but nothing binds the served bytes to the reviewed commit, and the artifact uploads before e2e/audit finish.
description: The site-preview artifact carries no in-band commit stamp, so serving a superseded run's bytes is undetectable in the preview itself, and it can be inspected while parallel e2e/audit jobs are still red. Stamp the artifact with its commit or document the trust assumption.
